impact.S:
The program Beyond the Degree has been very impactful for me. It has helped me realize that life is not only about studying and getting good grades, but also about developing real-life skills and the joy of earning for myself at a young age. Through the program, I have become more aware of personal growth and responsibility.

It has also helped improve my maturity and the way I see opportunities around me. Overall, it has given me valuable knowledge and experience beyond what I learn in school.
